scripts.build: npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.check: npm run check -w web && npm run build -w functions
scripts.test: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-broadcast --only auth,firestore,functions 'tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts'
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-broadcast --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.format: prettier --write web/src functions/src tests *.json web/*.json web/*.ts functions/*.json README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check web/src functions/src tests *.json web/*.json web/*.ts functions/*.json README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
